SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are a code repair verifier. Given the code patch and test summary, "
    "predict whether all tests pass (resolved) or any test fails (unresolved)."
)

def load_jsonl(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f]

def parse_prediction(text):
    if "</think>" in text:
        text = text.split("</think>")[-1]
    text = text.strip().lower()
    if text.startswith("resolved"):
        return 1
    if text.startswith("unresolved"):
        return 0
    if "resolved" in text and "unresolved" not in text:
        return 1
    if "unresolved" in text:
        return 0
    return -1

def main():
    model_name = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct"
    checkpoint_dir = "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_deepseek_traj_v2/best"

    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    bnb_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_8bit=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        model_name, quantization_config=bnb_config, device_map={"": 0}, trust_remote_code=True

    predictions = []

    acc = sum(p["correct"] for p in predictions) / len(predictions) * 100
    print(f"\nDone. Accuracy: {acc:.2f}%, unparseable: {n_unparseable}", flush=True)
    print(f"Saved to {output_path}", flush=True)

    traj_test = load_jsonl("/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data/traj_test.jsonl")

    # Build CLS test index: (problem_id, mutation_type, code) -> cls_index
    cls_key_to_idx = {}
    for i, d in enumerate(cls_test):
        key = (d["problem_id"], d["mutation_type"], d.get("code", "").strip())
        cls_key_to_idx[key] = i

    traj_to_cls = {}
    for j, d in enumerate(traj_test):
        key = (d["problem_id"], d["mutation_type"], d.get("code", "").strip())
        if key in cls_key_to_idx:
            traj_to_cls[j] = cls_key_to_idx[key]

    print(f"TRAJ->CLS alignment: {len(traj_to_cls)}/{len(traj_test)} matched")

    # Load CLS predictions (DeepSeek func-level)
    cls_preds_raw = load_jsonl("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_func_test/predictions.jsonl")
    cls_preds = {d["index"]: d for d in cls_preds_raw}

    # Load CWM predictions (DeepSeek func-level)
    cwm_preds_raw = load_jsonl("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_func_test/predictions.jsonl")
    cwm_preds = {d["index"]: d for d in cwm_preds_raw}

    traj_preds_raw = load_jsonl("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_traj_func_s42/predictions.jsonl")
    traj_preds = {d["index"]: d for d in traj_preds_raw}

    # === Pairwise complementarity on TRAJ subset (1032 instances) ===
    pairs = {"cls_vs_traj": {}, "cwm_vs_traj": {}, "cls_vs_cwm_subset": {}}
    three_way = {"all_correct": 0, "cls_only": 0, "cwm_only": 0, "traj_only": 0,
                 "cls_cwm_only": 0, "cls_traj_only": 0, "cwm_traj_only": 0,
                 "all_wrong": 0}

    n = 0
    for traj_idx, cls_idx in traj_to_cls.items():
        if traj_idx not in traj_preds or cls_idx not in cls_preds or cls_idx not in cwm_preds:

        n += 1
        cls_correct = cls_preds[cls_idx]["correct"]
        cwm_correct = cwm_preds[cls_idx]["correct"]
        traj_correct = traj_preds[traj_idx]["correct"]

        # Three-way classification
        if cls_correct and cwm_correct and traj_correct:
            three_way["all_correct"] += 1
        elif cls_correct and cwm_correct and not traj_correct:
            three_way["cls_cwm_only"] += 1
        elif cls_correct and not cwm_correct and traj_correct:
            three_way["cls_traj_only"] += 1
        elif not cls_correct and cwm_correct and traj_correct:
            three_way["cwm_traj_only"] += 1
        elif cls_correct and not cwm_correct and not traj_correct:

        elif not cls_correct and cwm_correct and not traj_correct:

        elif not cls_correct and not cwm_correct and traj_correct:

    def pairwise(a_correct_list, b_correct_list, name_a, name_b):

        a_only = sum(a and not b for a, b in zip(a_correct_list, b_correct_list))
        b_only = sum(not a and b for a, b in zip(a_correct_list, b_correct_list))
        both_w = sum(not a and not b for a, b in zip(a_correct_list, b_correct_list))
        n = len(a_correct_list)
        oracle = both_c + a_only + b_only
        complementarity = (a_only + b_only) / (a_only + b_only + both_w) * 100 if (a_only + b_only + both_w) > 0 else 0
        return {
            "n": n,
            "both_correct": both_c,
            f"{name_a}_only": a_only,
            f"{name_b}_only": b_only,
            "both_wrong": both_w,
            "oracle_accuracy": round(oracle / n * 100, 2),
            "complementarity": round(complementarity, 1),
            f"{name_a}_accuracy": round((both_c + a_only) / n * 100, 2),

    cwm_vs_traj = pairwise(cwm_c, traj_c, "cwm", "traj")
    cls_vs_cwm = pairwise(cls_c, cwm_c, "cls", "cwm")

    # Three-way oracle
    oracle_3 = sum(1 for a, b, c in zip(cls_c, cwm_c, traj_c) if a or b or c)
    oracle_3_acc = round(oracle_3 / n * 100, 2) if n > 0 else 0

    # === Full CLS vs CWM on 1890 instances ===
    cls_full = [cls_preds[i]["correct"] for i in range(1890)]
    cwm_full = [cwm_preds[i]["correct"] for i in range(1890)]

            "model": "deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct + LoRA",
            "test_set": "TRAJ subset of func-level mutations (HumanEval+MBPP)",

        "cls_vs_traj": cls_vs_traj,

        "cls_vs_cwm_full_1890": cls_vs_cwm_full,
        "three_way_oracle": {
            "n": n,
            "oracle_accuracy": oracle_3_acc,
            "breakdown": three_way,
            "note": "At least one of CLS/CWM/TRAJ correct",
        },
    }

    # Print summary
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Complementarity Analysis (n={n} shared instances)")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    for pair_name, pair_data in [("CLS vs TRAJ", cls_vs_traj), ("CWM vs TRAJ", cwm_vs_traj), ("CLS vs CWM (subset)", cls_vs_cwm)]:
        print(f"\n{pair_name}:")
        for k, v in pair_data.items():
            print(f"  {k}: {v}")
    print(f"\nThree-way oracle: {oracle_3_acc}% ({oracle_3}/{n})")
    print(f"Breakdown: {three_way}")
    print(f"\nCLS vs CWM (full 1890):")
    for k, v in cls_vs_cwm_full.items():
        print(f"  {k}: {v}")

    output_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/traj_complementarity_analysis.json"
